blocks.prompt: 4. Reduce \(\sin^{4}\theta\) to an expression involving only function of multiples of \(\theta\), raised to the first power.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul Example 13 jaisa hai; wahan \(\cos^4\theta\) tha, yahan \(\sin^4\theta\) hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\sin^4\theta\). Find kya karna hai? Aisi expression jis mein koi power na ho, sirf \(\cos 2\theta\), \(\cos 4\theta\) jaise multiple angles pehli power mein.
Rule kaunsa? Power ghatane wale formulas: \(\sin^2\theta = \frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}\) aur \(\cos^2 2\theta = \frac{1 + \cos 4\theta}{2}\).
Plan: \(\sin^4\theta\) ko \((\sin^2\theta)^2\) likh kar do dafa power ghatana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin^4\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\cos 2\theta\) aur \(\cos 4\theta\) wali expression, bina kisi square ke.
Tareeqa: \(\cos 2\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\) aur \(\cos 4\theta = 2\cos^2 2\theta - 1\) ko ulta kar ke power ghatane wale formulas banayenge. Har dafa power aadhi hoti hai aur angle dugna. Aise formulas calculus mein integration ke waqt bohat kaam aate hain.

\(\sin^2\theta\) ki power ghatayein
\[2\sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos 2\theta\]
\[\sin^2\theta = \dfrac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\) mein \(2\sin^2\theta\) ko ek taraf aur \(\cos 2\theta\) ko doosri taraf le gaye, phir 2 se divide kiya.

Square karein
\[\sin^4\theta = \left(\dfrac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}\right)^2\]
\[= \dfrac{1 - 2\cos 2\theta + \cos^2 2\theta}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^4\theta = (\sin^2\theta)^2\). \((a - b)^2 = a^2 - 2ab + b^2\) lagaya, aur neeche \(2^2 = 4\).
Dhyan dein: abhi bhi \(\cos^2 2\theta\) mein square baqi hai; yahan ruk jana adhoora jawab hai.

\(\cos^2 2\theta\) ki power ghatayein
\[\cos^2 2\theta = \dfrac{1 + \cos 4\theta}{2}\]
\[\sin^4\theta = \dfrac{1}{4}\left[1 - 2\cos 2\theta + \dfrac{1 + \cos 4\theta}{2}\right]\]
Kyun: \(\cos 4\theta = 2\cos^2 2\theta - 1\) (double angle formula, angle \(2\theta\) ke saath) se \(\cos^2 2\theta\) nikala aur rakh diya.

Simplify karein
\[= \dfrac{1}{8}\left[2 - 4\cos 2\theta + 1 + \cos 4\theta\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{8}\left[3 - 4\cos 2\theta + \cos 4\theta\right]\]
Kyun: Bracket ke andar ka fraction khatam karne ke liye bracket ko 2 se multiply kiya aur bahar wale \(\frac{1}{4}\) ko \(\frac{1}{8}\) kar diya, taake value na badle. Phir \(2 + 1 = 3\).

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 0\) aur \(\theta = 90^{\circ}\)
\[\theta = 0: \; \tfrac{1}{8}(3 - 4 + 1) = 0 = \sin^4 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[\theta = 90^{\circ}: \; \tfrac{1}{8}(3 + 4 + 1) = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\theta = 0\) par \(\cos 0 = 1\), jawab 0, aur \(\sin 0 = 0\). \(\theta = 90^{\circ}\) par \(\cos 180^{\circ} = -1\), \(\cos 360^{\circ} = 1\), jawab 1, aur \(\sin 90^{\circ} = 1\). Dono jagah sahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein yeh jawab "4." ki bajaye "14." number ke neeche likha hai. Jawab \(\frac{3 - 4\cos 2\theta + \cos 4\theta}{8}\) sahi hai, sirf number ghalat hai.
